takeaways.title: The AR Lens Gap
takeaways.body: Cartier puts 52.7% of impressions into AR Lenses. Chanel: 27.4%. Dior: 5.7%. Premium format, premium CPMs, and your competitors are all-in.

takeaways.title: The Silent Months
takeaways.body: Dior is dark 2 of 14 months. During those gaps, 7 competitors are still running — capturing attention unchallenged. Always-on presence doesn't mean always-heavy; even low-spend maintenance keeps you in the feed.

takeaways.title: The Efficiency Question
takeaways.body: 104 ads for 39M impressions (0.4M/ad). Gucci gets 107M from just 26 ads (4.1M/ad).

takeaways.title: The Content Opportunity
takeaways.body: 14 spotlight videos earned 201K organic views and 13K boosts. Fashion show behind-the-scenes content leads. This is a channel worth investing in.
